blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Cebu’s Toledo Xignex Trojans delivered a dominant performance, scoring identical 20-1 victories over the OCM Cebu Niños and Mindoro Tamaraws to notch back-to-back wins in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup on Saturday, October 17.
